_comment: DAA Stand Allocation — System Constants. These are fixed operational parameters derived from the Dublin Airport Reference Guide. DO NOT store soft priority weights here — those are operator UI inputs.

arrival_offsets_min._note: Minutes before STA when stand occupancy begins. Derived from 3-day schedule analysis (median early-arrival pattern).

_note_dep: Minutes after STD when stand is released. Derived from mean departure delay in 3-day data.
_note_buffer: Minimum gap required between consecutive aircraft on the same contact stand (daa hard rule).
_note_qt: Flights with turnaround < this value are Priority 2 (contact stand mandatory — remote bus incompatible).
_note_ls: Flights with turnaround >= this value are preferentially routed to remote stands.
_note_tow: Aircraft remaining on a contact stand > 2 hours after block-in will be towed to remote (daa policy).

turnaround_standard_min._note: Standard turnaround times by ICAO aircraft category. Used when no airline-specific agreement is recorded.

_note_cbp: Total CBP-eligible stands at Dublin Airport (all in Pier 4). Hard capacity ceiling for US preclearance ops.
_note_cascade: Maximum depth of conflict cascade tracing in Live Ops incremental reallocation.
_note_live: Minutes ahead of NOW that constitute the HAPPENING decision queue.
_note_warn: If a flight's predecessor is delayed by more than this many minutes, flag downstream flights as AT RISK.
_note_bucket: Granularity of seasonal demand matrix (30-minute slots).
_note_designated: Number of top routes (by annual frequency) that receive a preferred stand designation in the Seasonal Guide.
_note_upgrade: In Live Ops, how often to check if any remote-allocated flights can be upgraded to a contact stand that has freed up.
